Hi-Tech Lubricants Ltd Unveils New Engine Oil Product in Pakistan

Hi-Tech Lubricants Ltd, a prominent player in Pakistan’s chemicals sector, announced the launch of its latest engine oil product at an event in Lahore on Wednesday. The new product, branded as ZigmaX Ultra 5W-30, is designed to deliver enhanced engine protection and fuel efficiency for modern vehicles operating in local conditions.

The company’s CEO, Aamir Malik, told reporters, “With ZigmaX Ultra, we are responding to evolving consumer needs and stricter automotive standards. Our R&D team has worked extensively to ensure this product meets the latest requirements of both passenger cars and commercial fleets in Pakistan.” Malik added that the product features advanced additive technology, which aims to minimize engine wear, reduce emissions, and extend oil change intervals.

Hi-Tech Lubricants Ltd has been investing in product development to expand its market share in Pakistan’s rapidly growing automotive lubricants segment. According to data from the Pakistan Lubricants Association, demand for high-performance engine oils has risen by 8% year-on-year, driven by an expanding vehicle population and increased awareness of engine maintenance.

Industry analysts view the launch as a timely move. “As vehicles become more sophisticated, lubricant specifications are evolving. Companies that adapt their offerings to local requirements are likely to capture greater market share,” said Saad Farooq, an independent chemicals industry analyst based in Karachi.

The company plans to distribute ZigmaX Ultra 5W-30 through its extensive retail network, which includes over 2,000 dealers and service centers nationwide. In addition, Hi-Tech Lubricants Ltd will offer training sessions for mechanics and service professionals to highlight the benefits of the new formulation.

Shares of Hi-Tech Lubricants Ltd closed up 1.2% on the Pakistan Stock Exchange following the announcement. The company reported annual revenues of PKR 14.2 billion last year.
